answer.notes: The 2026/27 guide applies; intake continues until funds are committed. Outside-Basin applicants must partner locally and demonstrate Basin benefit. Additional eligibility conditions cover permitted land, planning and permitting progress, a targeted local footprint, effectiveness monitoring, Indigenous/community/technical input and climate mitigation/adaptation. Permitted land is Crown, local government, First Nations or conservation land; personally/commercially held land, BC Hydro/Fortis land and provincial/federal parks are excluded. Projects must not displace landowner or government/industry responsibilities, harm existing land users, mainly benefit applicants/members, involve routine activities, or undertake activities of political parties, advocacy/lobby groups or exclusive/discriminatory organisations. Review usually takes up to eight weeks and may require additional information. Funding requires a signed Contribution Agreement; expenses must follow funding approval and agreement signing. Optional wage subsidies require employers to cover 50% of wages and mandatory employment costs. No public copy of the invited application form or Contribution Agreement was found; reporting duties in the agreement remain unverified.
